script_function_compile: script a python function to compile it as TorchScript code using torch.jit.script
script_module_compile: script an nn.Module to compile its forward method and submodules as TorchScript code
script_class_decorate: decorate a python class with @torch.jit.script to compile it as a TorchScript class
create_script_list_build: create a ScriptList from a Python list with zero-copy overhead for TorchScript
create_script_dict_build: create a ScriptDict from a Python dictionary with zero-copy overhead for TorchScript
define_interface_annotate: define a TorchScript interface with @torch.jit.interface for polymorphic module types
annotate_attribute_type: annotate a ScriptModule attribute type using torch.jit.Attribute in __init__
script_with_example_inputs: script a function with example_inputs to enable profile-directed type inference via MonkeyType
